statement.name: GetComprehensiveActionHistory
statement.sql:
DECLARE @ResourceIds TABLE(ResourceTypeCode INT, ResourceValue UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);
OnResourceLookupCode, ActionTakenOn, ActionTakenOnString,
Comments, ProcessType, Action, Role, ActionTakenBy,
OnResourceID,
LookupCode, RoleId, ActionTakenOnDateTime
FROM ( SELECT
pfmUA.OnResourceLookUpCode,
FORMAT(pfmUA.OnDateTime,'MM/dd/yyyy hh:mm tt') AS 'ActionTakenOnString', CONVERT(DateTime, OnDateTime,101) AS 'ActionTakenOn', CAST(CAST(OnDateTime AS DATE) AS DATETIME) AS 'ActionTakenOnFilter', pfmUA.OnDateTime as ActionTakenOnDateTime,
ISNULL(pfmUA.Comments, ' ') AS Comments, cc.ResourceName AS 'ProcessType', dbo.ufnPFM_StripHTML(lkppfmUAT.LongDisplayValue) AS Action, acRol.DisplayValue AS 'Role', ISNULL(ppl.LastName + '', '') +', '+ ISNULL(ppl.FirstName, '') AS 'ActionTakenBy',
pfmUA.OnResourceID,
lkppfmUAT.LookupCode, ppl.FirstName, ppl.LastName, pfmUA.roleid FROM @ResourceIds ids INNER JOIN dbo.ConsolidatedPLatformUserAction pfmUA ON ids.ResourceTypeCode = pfmUA.OnResourceLookUpCode AND ids.ResourceValue = pfmUA.OnResourceID INNER JOIN dbo.LookupPlatformUserActionType lkppfmUAT ON pfmUA.ActionTypeLookUpCode = lkppfmUAT.LookupCode INNER JOIN dbo.People ppl ON pfmUA.ByUserID = ppl.UserId INNER JOIN dbo.LookupPlatformUserActionProcess lkppfmUAP ON lkppfmUAT.ProcessTypeLookUpCode = lkppfmUAP.LookupCode INNER JOIN dbo.LookupresourceType lkpRT ON OnResourceLookUpCode=lkpRT.LookupCode INNER JOIN LU_PFM_CAH_ResourceTypeConfiguration cc ON cc.ResourceTypeCode= OnResourceLookUpCode LEFT JOIN AC_Role acRol ON acRol.RoleId = pfmUA.RoleId ) AS Results
LookupCode
ActionTakenBy
ActionTakenOnFilter
RoleId

statement.name: GetResourceTypeConfiguration
statement.sql: SELECT LookupCode, ResourceName, ResourceTypeCode, ResourceCofigurationXML FROM LU_PFM_CAH_ResourceTypeConfiguration CAHResConfig

statement.name: GetProcessResourceTypeConfiguration
statement.sql: SELECT LookupCode, ResourceName, ResourceTypeCode, ResourceCofigurationXML FROM LU_PFM_CAH_ProcessResourceTypeConfiguration CAHResConfig

statement.name: GetCAHProcessTypes
statement.sql:
Select ResourceTypeCode as 'LookupCode',ResourceName as 'DisplayValue' FROM LU_PFM_CAH_ResourceTypeConfiguration
order by ResourceName asc

statement.name: GetCAHResourceTypes
statement.sql:
Select ResourceTypeCode as 'LookupCode',ResourceName as 'DisplayValue' FROM LU_PFM_CAH_ProcessResourceTypeConfiguration
order by ResourceName asc

statement.name: GetCAHRoles
statement.sql:
Select RoleId as 'LookupCode',DisplayValue,RoleId FROM AC_Role
order by DisplayValue asc

statement.name: GetCAHAction
statement.sql:
Select LookupCode,dbo.ufnPFM_StripHTML(LongDisplayValue) as 'DisplayValue' FROM LookupPlatformUserActionType
lookupcode in ( select Distinct ActionTypeLookUpCode from dbo.PlatformUserAction
)
order by dbo.ufnPFM_StripHTML(LongDisplayValue) asc
